result.summary: Several layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names and category chips, a loading spinner stuck on a popular restaurant card, and the last card cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: The third restaurant in 'Fastest near you' is clipped: name shows as 'Trattoria Piccol' and part of the card is cut off at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Give cards consistent width with wrapping or ellipsis, or make the row fully scrollable so names and cards are not truncated.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a large loading spinner over the food image, so the hero image looks incomplete or broken.
issues.suggestion: Hide or finish the image load state; don't leave an indefinite spinner covering the main photo.

issues.description: The last restaurant card (pizza with -20%) is cut off at the bottom by the tab bar, hiding the name, rating, and delivery details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the tab bar height so full cards can scroll into view.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off on the right (partial 'Healthy' and another chip), so the last filters are hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Add fade/peek affordance or ensure chips can scroll fully into view without being cropped.

issues.description: Notification bell has a red badge with no count or label, so the alert is unclear.
issues.suggestion: Show a numeric count or ensure the badge has an accessible label describing unread notifications.
